column1: # UI labels that must be WHOLE-NODE matches. zh <TAB> en <TAB> [note]
# NOT a forced-substring file (no 05_-10_ prefix), so these land in proseExact.
# That is the whole reason this file exists rather than folding into 10_html_ui:
# every key here is a one- or two-character word that appears inside dozens of
# longer phrases. As substrings they would be the 剑/巨剑徽章 bug all over again
# - 突破 alone would rewrite 境界突破, 破限突破, "突破思路" and the rest. As exact
# entries they can only fire when the label IS the entire text node, which is
# exactly what a <th> or an <option> is.
# --- family roster table headers (display.js update_displayed_family_members) ---
境界
column3: matches the ['境界','Realm'] v4.0 pair on #character_level_div

column1: 人数
突破
column3: green column; count today, or "-Nd" since the last one

column1: 死亡
培养策略
column3: header is 培养策略 ("cultivation policy"); the cells are a <select>

column1: # --- family cultivation strategies (the <select> in every roster row) ---
# An escalating risk ladder: payout 0.4x/1x/2x/5x/20x, breakthrough x1/x3/x5/x10
# /x30, death x1/x5/x15/x60/x300. Kept short because the <select> sizes itself
# to its widest option and the panel has ~385px for the whole table - see the
# #family_member_list rules in styleOverrides.
# The [N] prefixes are the game's own and are what the bankruptcy messages in
# main.js refer to, so they are preserved verbatim.
[1]常规工作
[2]家族试炼
[3]秘境探险
column3: 秘境 = Secret-Realm per 02_enemies; 探险 dropped for width

column1: [4]战场厮杀
[5]九死一生
column3: 九死一生 = "nine deaths, one life"

column1: 境界:
column3: V3.44 family unlock readout. index.html splits the sentence around <span id='family_next_realm'>, so this trailing chunk is its own text node - "解锁家族的 X 境界:". The bare 境界 entry above cannot reach it: applyProse strips leading separators and trailing QUOTES from a node, but not a trailing colon, so the node never reduces to 境界. Lowercase, since it now reads mid-sentence after the name
